# Bundled Markdown parser

`marked.mjs` is the unmodified ES module from **Marked 17.0.5**. Its MIT license is included in `MARKED-LICENSE.md`.

Source: <https://github.com/markedjs/marked> · Documentation: <https://marked.js.org/>

The builder imports this local file so a build needs only Node.js: no package installation, CDN, or network request. Marked runs at build time, not in visitors' browsers. Keep the license when updating this file. Content is authored by the repository owner; this project is not a service for accepting untrusted public Markdown submissions.
